Container.Name: Sexton
Container.Overview:
The Sexton — chat memory, voice, ears and music for teamspeak.phatt.vip, in one container (PHA-3099 / PHA-3428).
Runs, under supervisord: the Sexton bot and its audio bridge (one tsclientlib connection, one bot account), a local whisper.cpp server with ggml-base.en baked in, and the bgutil POT provider for the music lane. ffmpeg and yt-dlp ship at /opt/sexton-tools for the OpenClaw gateway to bind-mount.
The OpenClaw teamspeak channel plugin is NOT in here — it stays in the main OpenClaw gateway, which is already on this network. See image/README.md in the repo.
Container.Requires: The `phattvip` Docker network, with teamspeak6-server on it.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: The on-disk markdown chat log, one file per channel per day. Also what the bot rehydrates its history from on connect, so losing it loses the catch-up PM's memory.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds sexton-id.txt — the bot's TeamSpeak identity, which IS its server-side UID and permissions. Lose it and the Sexton comes back as a stranger. Keep it 0600 and back it up.

Config.Name: Channel
Config.Description: Channel name to sit in. Case-sensitive — it is resolved against the server's channel tree at startup.

Config.Name: TeamSpeak host
Config.Description: Container name of the TS6 server on this network. Leave as-is; the public hostname hairpins and gets flood-scored.

Config.Name: Identity file
Config.Description: Path, inside the container, to the identity string. Prefer this over passing the identity as a variable — a variable is visible in `docker inspect`.

Config.Name: Whisper threads
Config.Description: CPU threads for local transcription. 4 is the PHA-3228 setting; raise it only if the box is otherwise idle, since this competes with everything else on the RAID.

Config.Name: Duck gain
Config.Description: Music-lane gain floor (0..1) while someone is talking. Reaches the floor in 50ms, recovers in 800ms.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Rust tracing filter for the bot and bridge.
